REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews · Oct 8 — €100 million is now a plausible price for Francesco Pio Esposito. Inter have no intention of selling the 21-year-old; his contract runs to 2032.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 7 — Esposito scored twice for Italy over the break, part of seven goals from Inter's eleven internationals.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 7 — Cristian Chivu meets reporters Friday at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, at Appiano Gentile.
